# FIGURE S9 : PT PARAMETERS ~ Sexe
# Display plots of PT parameters with Sexe. Each point represent a Pt parameters during a particular 1500 trial period for an individual

```{r}
# Vérifier l'ordre des catégories
filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(age_category = factor(age_category, 
                                levels = c("juvenile", "subadult", "adult")))

mean_data <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(monkey, sex, age_category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rho_g = mean(rho_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rho_l = mean(rho_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_elo   = mean(elo, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_alpha_graw = mean(alpha_graw, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_alpha_lraw = mean(alpha_lraw, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_lambda = mean(lambdaraw, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_COP = mean(COP, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Graphique
ggplot(mean_data, aes(x = sex, y = mean_rho_g)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  # on mappe la couleur à age_category
  geom_jitter(aes(color = age_category), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, size = 5) +
  labs(
    x = "Sexe",
    y = expression(rho["+"] ~ "(risk attitude in gains)"),
    color = "Age Category"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("juvenile" = "#a6cee3",   # bleu clair
               "subadult" = "#1f78b4",   # bleu moyen
               "adult"    = "#08306b")   # bleu foncé
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 36),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 36),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 28),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24)
  ) +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 1, label = expression(italic("risk aversion")),
           color = "black", hjust = 1, size = 8) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = -1, label = expression(italic("risk seeking")),
           color = "black", hjust = 1, size = 8)



# Graphique
ggplot(mean_data, aes(x = sex, y = mean_rho_l)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  # couleur liée à age_category
  geom_jitter(aes(color = age_category), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, size = 5) +
  labs(
    x = "Sexe",
    y = expression(rho["-"] ~ "(risk attitude in losses)"),
    color = "Age Category"
  ) +
  # dégradé orange clair -> foncé (sans rouge)
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("juvenile" = "#fee6ce",  # orange très clair
               "subadult" = "#fdae6b",  # orange moyen
               "adult"    = "#e6550d")  # orange foncé
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 36),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 36),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 28),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24)
  ) +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 1, label = expression(italic("risk aversion")),
           color = "black", hjust = 1, size = 8) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = -1, label = expression(italic("risk seeking")),
           color = "black", hjust = 1, size = 8)




ggplot(mean_data, aes(x = sex, y = mean_alpha_graw)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = "white") +
  # couleur liée à age_category
  geom_jitter(aes(color = age_category), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, size = 5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Sexe",
    y = expression(alpha["+"] ~ "(probability distortion in gains)"),
    color = "Age Category"
  ) +
  # palette bleu clair -> foncé
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("juvenile" = "#a6cee3",  # bleu clair
               "subadult" = "#1f78b4",  # bleu moyen
               "adult"    = "#08306b")  # bleu foncé
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 36),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 36),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 28),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24)
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 10,
           label = expression(italic("S shape")),
           color = "black", hjust = 1, size = 8) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.1,
           label = expression(italic("inverted S shape")),
           color = "black", hjust = 1, size = 8) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10),
    limits = c(0.1, 10)
  )

ggplot(mean_data, aes(x = sex, y = mean_lambda)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = "white") +

  geom_jitter(aes(color = age_category), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, size = 5) +

ggplot(mean_data, aes(x = sex, y = mean_COP)) +
```
